text:
sanjay: Heads-up — ACME POC orderform just came back from procurement with DPA/POA redlines. They want net60 and HSM attestation. Need legal + finance signoff. Also asking if we can e-sign via their DocuSign tenant (they prefer bank wiring if e-sign fails). Can we route signatures to two signers and one exec? cc @maria @kevin

maria: Thanks. Can you drop the redline here? We need to confirm retention clause and subprocessors. HSM attestation — is that KMS/HSM or just SOC2 phrasing?

sanjay: Uploading their annotated orderform in a sec. They're asking to replace 'KMS' with 'HSM-backed KMS' and to add 'data residency: EU' as an option. POC billing is metered + monthly minimum. They listed SLA 99.9% for hosted.

alex: For the POC we can do metered + a $2k monthly minimum. Hosted SLA is 99.9% for API but HSM-backed keys require Private or Dedicated with customer-managed HSM. On Hosted we can offer BYOK (KMS) + SOC2 attestation, not full HSM attestation.

jamie: Routing idea: envelope order = Procurement (ACME procurement) -> Finance (Kevin) -> Legal (Maria) -> Exec (ACME Exec). Fallback if e-sign fails: wire instructions + PO + scanned wet-ink. How urgent is signature?

kevin: Net60 is okay for enterprise but needs RevOps approval. Can we agree Net30 + credit hold as a compromise? If not, finance needs an AR approval ticket before signing. Also confirm invoicing entity and billing contact.

maria: I'll review the redline. If they insist on HSM attestation we'll need eng + legal to confirm feasibility; likely only available on Private. @alex can you confirm allowable language? Also we should push back on unlimited liability in the SLA.

alex: Suggested limit of liability: 'liability limited to fees paid to Redwood in the 12 months preceding the claim.' For HSM: we can provide attestation for on-prem/private deployments; for Hosted we can provide KMS/BYOK plus logs.

sanjay: Uploaded: [link to orderform-redline.pdf]. Pasted snippet:
```
OrderForm:
 - Commitment: Metered
 - Monthly Minimum: $2000
 - Net Terms: 60
 - Data Residency: EU
 - KMS: HSM-backed (requested)
 - SLA: 99.9% hosted
```

jamie: I'll create the DocuSign envelope and test routing. If Exec needs to sign add 'exec_sign=true' in the envelope metadata. Creating envelope now :eyes:

docu-sign-bot: Envelope created (env_8923). Sent to first signer.

sanjay: Thanks all. Target: get legal redline back by EOD tomorrow so we can aim for POC kickoff this week. I'll ping the ACME buyer to confirm billing contact.

maria: Got it — I'll send initial counter redline by EOD. Please attach any SOW or SSO details we should reference.

kevin: FYI finance needs billing contact + billing email for invoice flow. cc billing@acme.com

sanjay: Added billing contact. I'll update thread with final envelope link and any repo notes after legal posts redline.

maria: One more ask — if they want data residency EU we need to confirm region deployment and data purge schedule. @alex can you confirm standard retention?

alex: Standard retention is 90 days for logs + 7 years for audit artifacts upon request. For EU residency we'll pin region and update SOW.

sanjay: Great. Putting this in the sales checklist: attach redline, confirm billing entity, revise orderform, send to RevOps for Net60 approval if needed.

jamie: Envelope status: env_8923 -> Signed by Procurement. Moving to Finance. Will update thread. :white_check_mark:
